source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: After this model shoots in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), pick 1 enemy unit hit by at least one of those attacks. Until that phase ends, friendly models that left this **TRANSPORT** by [disembarking](vsdata:core-rule/disembarking) earlier this turn may re-roll **Wound rolls** for attacks against the picked unit.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 8 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

selection.condition: hit by at least one of those attacks

effect.appliesTo: attacks by friendly models that disembarked from this TRANSPORT this turn, targeting the selected unit
